title: UNISFA translation routing and centralized capacity
decision_reason: Retained governing-text extraction identifies a review/control mechanism; underlying complete operational records, accountable owner confirmation and financial validation are absent.
current_arrangement: The retained A/RES/80/275 paragraph 9 extraction requests review of Translation Unit centralization and performance in the 2027/28 budget. Actual job-level demand, staffing and delivery data are absent.
testable_mechanism: Test whether centralized assignment and common terminology reduce repeated translation or idle capacity while meeting field language and confidentiality needs. Centralization itself is not proof of efficiency.
feasible_alternative_to_test: Pilot an owner-approved routing rule with an escalation route for urgent or sensitive work; retain local coverage where access or turnaround requires it.
safeguards: Urgent operational interpretation and field access
No unapproved removal of mandated language capability
cost_perimeter_and_nonadditivity: Compare the same language pairs, urgency classes and delivered quality over matched periods. Include retained field staff, central staff, vendor contracts, secure connectivity, coordination and rework; distinguish translation from interpretation. No cost or capacity baseline is available.
minimum_records: Job ID, language pair, word count or interpretation hours, request/delivery timestamps and urgency
Requester, receiving unit, assignment route, duplication links and quality/rework assessment
Unique post/contract IDs, actual paid hours and vendor invoices
Approved service standards and documented field/security exceptions
custodian_roles_to_confirm: UNISFA substantive requesters and mission support
DOS language-service coordination and procurement roles

source_snapshot.directive_paraphrase: Review centralization and performance of Translation Unit in the 2027/28 budget

source_snapshot.decision_guardrail: The GA inclusive appropriation includes shared support UNLB and RSCE; adopted_minus_proposed compares GA mission-maintenance gross against SG mission-maintenance gross; no new savings inferred

case_specific_limit: A review requested for the 2027/28 budget is not proof that centralization was implemented or that current local work is waste.
source_review_scope: Retained repository extractions; primary resolution bytes are not newly authenticated and no current implementation or compliance determination is made.
handling: Use approved restricted intake, minimum necessary fields and pseudonymization; no live financial, personnel, medical or security-sensitive records in this public repository.
reopen_condition: Confirmed accountable owner and authorized complete linked records permit a validation-ready assessment; a draft request is not authority or evidence receipt.
